knowledge.plain_language_summary: Option 3 of three for the projecting blade sign. Same size class as option 2 but with a red-dominant body and a figural laser-cut acrylic applique (a classical figure tied to the venue theme) as the signature element, with the venue name in open-faced exposed-lamp channel letters.
knowledge.rationale: Leads with a figural emblem rather than a typographic article word, making the applique the brand signature; keeps the simple open-faced exposed-lamp letter construction of option 2.
knowledge.tradeoffs: The figural applique is the most distinctive of the three but is the most theme-specific, so it ages with the venue's identity rather than reading as a neutral marquee.
knowledge.when_to_use: When a distinctive figural emblem is wanted as the identity anchor over a purely typographic marquee.
